steps.step: Prepare separate Contracts for relations, the confidentiality prompt in both directions, a restricted target, the Matter links, and ending and archiving; and two open Matters
steps.expected: Prerequisite records exist for this role
steps.actual: Open Contracts A=C-165, B=C-166, C=C-167, E=C-168, F=C-169, H=C-170, J=C-171; Confidential D=C-172, G=C-173, I=C-174; open Matters M1=M-61, M2=M-62. Priya Raman is on none of their teams.

steps.step: Set parent: Cancel leaves no parent; Set parent places A under B; B lists A under Children; choosing A as B's parent is refused as a cycle
steps.expected: Parent relation saves; Cancel changes nothing; a parent choice that creates a cycle is refused
steps.actual: Cancel left C-165 with no parent. The picker showed "Set parentC-166DOC-032 compat compat-b C20 B legal_team_member 1790580641899CancelSet parent"; Set parent saved. C-165: "Related contractsAdd linkParentC-166 DOC-032 compat compat-b C20 B legal_team_member 1790580641899DraftRemove parent". C-166: "Related contractsSet parentAdd linkChildrenC-165 DOC-032 compat compat-b C20 A legal_team_member 1790580641899Draft". Choosing C-165 as C-166's parent was refused: "That contract already sits under this one. Pick another parent."; C-166 still has no parent.

steps.step: Add link Related, Renews and Amends from A to C; check direction on both records; a duplicate Renews is refused; the picker does not offer A itself
steps.expected: Typed links save with the stated direction; self-links and duplicates are refused
steps.actual: Related, Renews and Amends answered 201, 201, 201. C-165: "Related contractsAdd linkParentC-166 DOC-032 compat compat-b C20 B legal_team_member 1790580641899DraftRemove parentRelatedC-167 DOC-032 compat compat-b C20 C legal_team_member 1790580641899DraftRemove linkRenewsC-167 DOC-032 compat compat-b C20 C legal_team_member 1790580641899DraftRemove linkAmendsC-167 DOC-032 compat compat-b C20 C legal_team_member 1790580641899DraftRemove link". C-167: "Related contractsSet parentAdd linkRelatedC-165 DOC-032 compat compat-b C20 A legal_team_member 1790580641899DraftRemove linkRenewed byC-165 DOC-032 compat compat-b C20 A legal_team_member 1790580641899DraftRemove linkAmended byC-165 DOC-032 compat compat-b C20 A legal_team_member 1790580641899DraftRemove link". A second Renews answered 409: "These two contracts are already linked that way.". In C-165's own picker a title search found C-166, and a search for C-165's own title offered: "No contracts to link." (not C-165 itself); a direct self-link write answered 409.

steps.step: Remove link on the Related row removes only that relationship; Remove parent clears the parent; both records still exist
steps.expected: Removal affects only the chosen relationship
steps.actual: Links before: amends,related,renews; after Remove link on the Related row: amends,renews (3 rows had named C-167). Remove parent cleared the parent. C-165 now reads "Related contractsSet parentAdd linkRenewsC-167 DOC-032 compat compat-b C20 C legal_team_member 1790580641899DraftRemove linkAmendsC-167 DOC-032 compat compat-b C20 C legal_team_member 1790580641899DraftRemove link"; C-166 and C-167 still exist.

steps.step: Flag as confidential? after linking Confidential D to open E: the prompt names E and Flag as confidential sets E's flag
steps.expected: The prompt names the Contract that is not yet Confidential and sets only that flag
steps.actual: Prompt: "Flag as confidential?C-172 is confidential but C-168 is not. Flag C-168 as confidential too?No, leave it openFlag as confidential". Flag as confidential (200) set C-168 Confidential; C-172 stays Confidential.

steps.step: Flag as confidential? after linking open F to Confidential G: the prompt names F (this Contract) and accepting sets F's flag
steps.expected: The flagged Contract can be this Contract
steps.actual: Prompt: "Flag as confidential?C-173 is confidential but C-169 is not. Flag C-169 as confidential too?No, leave it openFlag as confidential". Flag as confidential (200) set this Contract C-169 Confidential.

steps.step: No, leave it open after linking open H to Confidential I changes nothing; a reader without access to I sees Restricted contract on H and cannot open I
steps.expected: The link does not change either flag or grant access; the restricted target does not leak its details
steps.actual: Prompt: "Flag as confidential?C-174 is confidential but C-170 is not. Flag C-170 as confidential too?No, leave it openFlag as confidential". No, leave it open kept C-170 open and C-174 Confidential; the link exists. Priya Raman's C-170 card: "Related contractsSet parentAdd linkRelatedRestricted contract" with no link to C-174; a direct read of C-174 answered 404; the relations read does not include its title.

steps.step: Link to Matter: search, inspect the M- reference, Link; the card then offers Unlink and no Link to Matter; Unlink before moving to another Matter; a confidentiality mismatch warns without changing flags
steps.expected: One Matter at a time; the mismatch advice changes neither flag
steps.actual: C-171 search offered "M-61 DOC-032 compat compat-b C20 M1 legal_team_member 1790580641899"; Link answered 201; the card then showed 1 Unlink and 0 Link to Matter buttons. A second link to M-62 answered 409. After Unlink, the Contract linked to M-62 (201). Confidential C-172 -> open M-61: the dialog warned "These records have different Confidential flags. Linking will not change either one."; after Link, "Confidentiality differsC-172 and M-61 keep independent Confidential flags. Consider aligning them if that matches the work. This suggestion changes neither record.Leave them as they are"; Leave them as they are kept C-172 Confidential and M-61 open.

steps.step: End: use the Stage control to choose Expired (Ended); check Status and History; the Contract remains editable; the default Contracts view excludes it until Filter -> Show ended; reopen with Active and History keeps the Expired change
steps.expected: Ending records the lifecycle change without freezing the record; the ended filter reveals it; reopening is another recorded change
steps.actual: Stage control -> Expired set Status Expired (stage ended); a Description edit then saved (200). History showed "Nadia Haddad changed the statusDraft → Expiredthis minute". The Contracts list (view "Default view; previously selected My commercial desk") did not list C-171 after paging; Filter -> Show ended ("Filter1") listed it. Choosing Active reopened it (Active); History still shows the Expired change and the Active change.

steps.step: Archive from Contract actions: Archived marker and read-only message; Status unchanged; linked Contract and Matter are not archived and the Matter's Linked Contracts omits it; find it with Show archived plus Show ended; Restore from Contract actions and from the known C- address
steps.expected: Archiving is separate from ending; restore re-enables editing and keeps the Status
steps.actual: Related link to C-167 (201); Status Expired. Archive showed the Archived marker and "This contract is archived — it is out of the contract list. Restore it to edit."; Title was not editable; Status stayed Expired. C-167 and M-62 were not archived; Before archiving M-62's Linked Contracts listed C-171; while archived it read "Linked Contracts0New contractLink ContractNo Contracts are linked to this Matter.". List filter started as "Filter"; Show archived alone ("Filter1") did not list the Ended record; with Show ended too ("Filter2") it did. Restore from Contract actions removed the marker and re-enabled editing; Status still Expired, so the default view still excludes it. Archived again (200), the known /contracts/171 address offered Restore (1) and restored it. Afterwards the reviewer cleared its list filters ("Filter" before) and re-selected view "My commercial desk".
